messages:
Alyssa: Heads-up — NovaBank POC kickoff tomorrow. They insist on 7 year audit log retention, HSM-backed key management, and HIPAA coverage. Asking for POC pricing options and any special commit/discount we can offer. Can we confirm technical feasibility and ballpark $ for retention + HSM add-on? cc @Sasha @Mikey - Solutions @Jason - Deal Desk
Sasha: Short answer: doable, but not on Hosted API with customer-managed HSM. Options: Dedicated w/ customer BYOK (limited HSM integration) or Private (full HSM & on-prem key control).
Sasha: Retention note: long-term logs are storage-heavy — recommend cold-tier archive + export workflow. We should quote both hot and cold storage.
Mikey - Solutions: For the POC we can stand up a Private eval in their VPC for 2 weeks (no production keys) to demo HSM flows. If they require actual HSM-backed encryption with their HSM, that'll be operationally heavier — needs infra lead + 2-3 business days to coord.
Alyssa: NovaBank budget asked for a single-line number today to keep momentum. They asked what a 12mo commit vs a 24mo commit looks like including the compliance add-ons.
Jason - Deal Desk: Need estimated ARR or committed spend to quote discount. Quick rules of thumb we can apply: 12mo commit -> up to 15% off list, 24mo or > $400k commit -> up to 25% off, enterprise exceptions require legal signoff. HSM add-on and extended retention are typically treated as add-ons (flat monthly + per-GB storage).
Jason - Deal Desk: Proposal suggestion: HSM management (Redwood-managed integration + monitoring) = $6,000/mo, long-term audit storage = $0.004/GB-month for cold-tier. These are placeholder numbers — need exact sizing from engineering.
Priya - Compliance: HIPAA requires a BAA and review of logs to ensure PHI isn't over-exposed. If logs contain PHI, keys must be under customer control or we must sign BAA and attest to controls. Also confirm whether NovaBank needs log redaction or tokenization.
Sasha: Can someone pull rough ingest estimate? We need GB/month to compute retention cost. Also any requirement for searchable logs vs cold-archive will change cost by ~10x.
Alyssa: Customer provided approximate event volume: ~200k events/day, avg 1KB/event. So ~6GB/month raw, 504GB for 7 years (w/o compression). They might compress/partition but use this for pricing.
Mikey - Solutions: With compression + dedupe expect ~50-60% reduction. If we price cold-tier at Jason's $0.004/GB-month -> 504GB * $0.004 = ~$2.02/mo? wait math check. (we should do per-month calc correctly)
Mikey - Solutions: Correct calc: 504GB total * $0.004/GB-month -> $2.02/month across entire 7yr? that looks off because GB-month multiplies retention months. Better approach: monthly footprint ~6GB -> cost = 6GB * $0.004 = $0.024/month; over 84 months = 504 GB-month -> $2.016 total across 7yrs. So cold-tier is cheap, but retrieval and query layers add ops cost.
Jason - Deal Desk: Right — storage itself is small in this example. Main cost is management, HSM add-on, and any egress/export for audits. For discounting, if they commit to 12mo Reserved Dedicated + HSM add-on we can propose: 12mo + 20% off list for the first-year (compensates setup), 24mo -> 30% off subject to legal. Need an ARR number to finalize.
Priya - Compliance: Also require SOC2 scope confirmation. If they want scoped SOC2 for their instance, that's a separate engagement and cost. Add a line: "SOC2 scope extension" to the quote if requested.
Alyssa: From customer: likely to do 12mo reserved capacity and then reassess. Estimated start commit = $180k ARR (incl usage + add-ons). They also asked about a one-time fee waiver for HSM setup during POC.
Jason - Deal Desk: For $180k ARR we can offer: 12mo commit, 18% off list, waive up to $10k of onboarding fees (one-time) for POC, and include a 30-day extension on retention logs export for free. HSM monthly add-on stays. Final approval pending legal & finance signoff.
Sasha: Technical checklist for the proposal (to include in deal ticket):- Target deployment mode: Private (preferred) or Dedicated - HSM integration mode (customer HSM vs managed) - Expected ingest GB/month and retention policy - Searchability requirements (fast queries vs archive) - Export/forensics SLA
Alyssa: I'm going to open the Deal Desk ticket now with the estimate and attach the security questionnaire the customer sent.
DeployBot: POC environment request received — ticket #POC-9221 created and assigned to eng-infra. ETA: 48-72 hours for provisioning.
Jason - Deal Desk: Thanks — once ticket is created tag me and attach projected ARR sheet + the scope we discussed. I'll queue for approval. :+1:
Priya - Compliance: I'll draft the BAA + checklist and post in the ticket.
Alyssa: Awesome — thanks team. I'll update NovaBank after we get Deal Desk reply and infra ETA. :thumbsup:
